findings.message: settle_admissions adds a backward-compatibility branch the ticket does not ask for. It looks up a completed effect under the legacy key `ticket-plane/<stem>/confirmed/<request_id>` and re-journals `draft_confirmed` from it. The ticket specifies a single key, `ticket-plane/<stem>/<verb>/<request_id>`, and the repo bans compat shims and parallel paths. If this branch is dropped, an old accepted confirm re-runs through the shared verdict function and either applies or completes with that function's refusal. That outcome is already covered.
findings.paved_road: Delete the `old_key`/`old` lookup and its `draft_confirmed` re-append. Every accepted null-hold_id request then runs only through `Effects(...).run(apply, key=f"ticket-plane/{stem}/{verb}/{request_id}")`.

findings.message: Scope-in requires one lock-free function holding every keep, kill and draft-promotion rule, so that there is one implementation of the verdict rules. After this diff, `runner.confirm_draft`, a separate draft-promotion implementation with its own stamp/commit/`draft_confirmed` logic, still exists. Its only live caller was serve's settle_admissions path, which this diff removed. `runner.committed_draft` likewise has no remaining caller. That leaves a second, unused copy of the draft-promotion rules alongside `verdict_locked`.
findings.paved_road: Remove `runner.confirm_draft` and `runner.committed_draft` from chupa/runner.py. `MergeQueue.confirm_draft` in chupa/mergequeue.py is now unreferenced and outside the fence, so file it in the Suggestion Box for removal instead of editing it here.
